svg.aria-label: themis. Two files, one text. The themis rule gate audits a bloated CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md pair of about 1,065 tokens rule by rule: generic advice and a script the manifest already shows are cut, a shouted rule is rewritten without emphasis, a real gotcha is kept. What stays lands in CLAUDE.md, about 172 tokens, and is copied to an identical AGENTS.md.

text.tspan: A Claude Code plugin that keeps CLAUDE.md and
AGENTS.md short, and the two identical.

g.text: - All money values are integer cents; never floats.
